messages:
Elena (Support): FYI customer 'Granite AI' (acct GAI-21) reports a $2,400 promo credit showing on the wrong account (GAI-210). They want it moved to GAI-21 as a credit on next invoice, not a refund. Invoice INV-2026-9921 shows -2400.00 on GAI-210.

Marco (Finance Ops): Can you paste the invoice line and any promo id or external tag? I'll check recon logs.

Elena (Support): Promo tag: spring_lab_credit_2400. Snippet: 
```
INV-2026-9921 | GAI-210 | Promo Credit | SPRING_LAB_CREDIT_2400 | -2400.00 | USD
INV-2026-9921 | GAI-21  | Usage       | API-REQUESTS           |  2400.00 | USD
```
Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/fin/INV-9921-snap

ReconcileBot: recon-2026-05-02 matched promo tag spring_lab_credit_2400 -> org GAI-210 (legacy mapping due to org suffix collision). Flag: manual review recommended.

Tess (Billing): Looks like a mapping collision from our legacy importer. Proposed steps: 1) reverse negative promo line on GAI-210; 2) create manual credit MC-9921 for GAI-21 $2,400; 3) add partner-facing memo; 4) if revenue already recognized, post JV to reverse. Need GL code and CFO approval.

Marco (Finance Ops): Tax 0. GL 7550-PartnerCredits. @Gina can you approve? We'll tag revenue ops if needed.

Gina (CFO): Approved. Goodwill/manual credits under $5k for system misapplication are pre-authorized. Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits and include a reversing JV if invoice was recognized. :white_check_mark:

Omar (Revenue Ops): Check period on INV-2026-9921. If recognized in 2026-04, we'll need JV-REV-9921 to reverse recognized revenue. Marco, please notify revenue when you queue the JV.

Lola (Account Exec): Partner needs an ETA and a short confirmation note they can send to procurement: "Credit reallocated to account GAI-21 due to promo misapplication; ref INV-2026-9921; credit applied to next invoice; no refund." Can we promise it shows on next cycle (2026-06-01)?

Tess (Billing): Yes. I'll create MC-9921 today, memo attached, will appear on next billing cycle 2026-06-01. Also filing internal ticket BILL-3199 to fix suffix collision in promo->org mapping.

Marco (Finance Ops): Actions completed: manual credit MC-9921 for GAI-21 created amount $2,400.00, GL 7550-PartnerCredits; JV-REV-9921 queued pending revenue ops confirmation; partner memo added; filed BILL-3199.

Elena (Support): Thanks all, sending confirmation to the customer now and marking the support case pending their acknowledgment. :thumbsup:

Gina (CFO): Nice. Please add this exact scenario to the billing playbook and include the note about name/suffix collisions.

Omar (Revenue Ops): Noted; will verify JV once Marco marks it ready.

Tess (Billing): Closing loop here. If partner disputes anything after seeing the next statement, reopen and we'll escalate.
